question: For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?
sql:
SELECT m.duration, w1.name, w2.name 
FROM Matches m 
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON w1.id = m.winner_id 
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON w2.id = m.loser_id 
WHERE m.title_id IN (SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) FROM Belts WHERE name LIKE '%NXT%') 
  AND m.title_change != 0 
  AND m.duration IS NOT NULL 
  AND m.duration != ''
ORDER BY m.duration
LIMIT 10
